name: keel-policy-engine-spike
description: ISOLATED spike (NOT part of the pnpm workspace) — ADR-0004 opa-wasm measured spike. Uses npm + its own node_modules so it never touches the root lockfile.

scripts.build:wasm: ./opa build -t wasm -e keel/default/verdict -e keel/default/explain -o bundle.tar.gz keel-default.rego && tar -xzf bundle.tar.gz && ls -l policy.wasm
